title: Clean Concrete
description: Resource Pack that makes concrete textures more clean and solid.
body:
# Clean Concrete

This is a Resource Pack that makes concrete textures more clean and solid.

## Example:
### Vanilla textures:

![Concrete blocks with Vanilla texturese](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a98bda403a7a730310760b3ad7661b6b89ec2cfb_0.webp)

![Black box using Vanilla Textures](https://isotonicbunk.github.io/assets/img/cc_box_vanilla.png)

![Smiley face using Vanilla Textures](https://isotonicbunk.github.io/assets/img/cc_smile_vanilla.png)


### Resource Pack Textures:

![Concrete blocks using Texture Pack](https://isotonicbunk.github.io/assets/img/cc_rb_rp.png)

![Black box using Texture Pack](https://isotonicbunk.github.io/assets/img/cc_box_rp.png)

![Smiley face using Texture Pack](https://isotonicbunk.github.io/assets/img/cc_smile_rp.png)

Changes is more visible in-game.

 This Resource Pack is for version 1.21.X, but you can try to use it in older versions
